verdict.rationale: AWS documents a Cost Explorer API for programmatically querying cost and usage data (aws-docs-16) and AWS Budgets for tracking/alerting on costs (aws-docs-14, aws-docs-48), satisfying the 'queryable via API' part of the story. However, the pack has no explicit documentation of scheduled cost/usage exports (e.g., Cost and Usage Reports to S3) or resource-level granularity in the exported/queried data, and community evidence highlights billing opacity/confusion (aws-comm-1, aws-comm-3) rather than confirming granular exports. missing for 10: explicit scheduled export mechanism (e.g., CUR) with resource-level tagging/granularity, independent confirmation that Cost Explorer API returns resource-level detail.
